subtitle: Mysore Palace · Ooty Lake · Adiyogi Shiva · Brindavan Gardens
inclusions: Mumbai to Mumbai SL Train Tickets (3AC upgrade available)

itinerary.title: Reach Bangalore & Drive to Mysore
itinerary.description: Reporting Station : CSMT : 07:00 AM 16 April 2026 (Thursday) Mumbai to Bangalore till 06:00 AM

itinerary.title: Mysore Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for Mysore sightseeing. Visit Mysore Zoo, Mysore Palace, and Krishnaraja Sagar (KRS) Dam. Experience the royal heritage of the city. Dinner and overnight stay. 17 April 2026 (Friday)

itinerary.title: Travel to Ooty
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from hotel. Departure to Ooty (3-4 hrs). Check in at hotel. After rest, visit Doddabetta Park and Botanical Garden. Enjoy the cool Nilgiri air. Dinner and overnight stay. 18 April 2026 (Saturday)

itinerary.title: Ooty Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast Dinner & rest 19 April 2026 (Sunday) 1.Dolphin’s Nose 2.Sim’s Park

itinerary.title: Coimbatore Sightseeing & Adiyogi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from hotel. Proceed to Coimbatore (3 hrs). Visit the magnificent Adiyogi Shiva statue, the 112-ft iconic landmark. Spend time in meditation and reflection. Dinner and overnight stay. 20 April 2026 (Monday)

itinerary.title: Return Journey to Mumbai
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from hotel. Board train for Mumbai. Reach Mumbai (Panvel station) by 05:00 PM. Return home with sweet memories! 21 April 2026 (Tuesday)
